title: Hermitage Theatre
visualBrief: Hermitage Theatre exterior: exact named native main block and small rear-east courtyard; pale blue-green three-tier Neoclassical river front with ten engaged round giant-order columns/abstract capitals, rusticated ground storey/arched transoms, triangular upper-window pediments, simple statue niches/bust medallions, projecting cornices and low green faceted metal roof with rounded upper canal-side corner. Only the main theatre record is replaced. Preserve the independently identified large rear block, Old Hermitage covered gallery, lower road bridge, quays/roads/Neva/canal and neighboring buildings. Original coarse statuary silhouettes only; no copied sculpture/inscriptions or furnished auditorium/historic Peter I rooms.
